_comment: v0.16.1 #6 ECONOMY: the brew arm had ZERO live coverage before this script -- nothing in qa/ ever cast [Hedge Remedy] at eloise_cauldron or inn_witch_kettle, which is exactly why the unbounded brew->sell arbitrage shipped. The loop is now INGREDIENT-BOUNDED and this is the proof a player can see: one cast turns the held dried_yarrow_bundle into a remedy_draught (item_gained + item_lost on the same cast, witch_craft_used 1), and the very next cast is REFUSED at the item gate with the authored hint, banking nothing. assert_event_count pins that the second press produced no second remedy -- the arbitrage's whole engine. The consuming-recipe dup-output refusal (a held remedy must not bank a free witch_craft_used) is unit-proven in test_sim_core, which can stage the two-items-held state a save fixture cannot (inventory never stacks).

steps._comment: Start posture: one yarrow bundle in the pack, standing on the cauldron's only cardinal approach, facing it.
Cast 1 -- the ingredient gate is MET, so the arm resolves and CONSUMES.
Cast 2 -- no yarrow left. The gate returns BEFORE any effect resolves: authored hint, no second remedy, counter unmoved. This is the bound.

payload_contains.text: The kettle wants yarrow before it gives anything back.
